Atelier Cho Thompson is a bicoastal, multidisciplinary design and concept firm, engaged in the art of architecture, interiors, graphics, brand strategy, furniture, installations, and exhibitions. The firm has won the Architect's Newspaper Young Architect Award, Anna Hernandez/Luna Textiles IIDA Visionary Award, Dezeen Longlist for Emerging Architect, and various awards from the IIDA, AIA, NYCxDesign, Contract Magazine, and more. Our expertise and passions transcend the conventional boundaries between these disciplines, resulting in a richness borne of the cross-pollination of ideas and strategies from across this spectrum of design. This integrated design approach produces holistic environments in which all elements are deeply related to each other and to the heart of a central concept.
Join our multidisciplinary design practice as a full-time Intermediate Designer / Architect based in our San Francisco office. Our work culture is very creative and collaborative. Our project portfolio ranges from hospitality, historic adaptive reuse, commercial TIs, cafes & restaurants, schools, and residences to public projects, product & furniture design, branding, and design strategy.
We are looking for a good fit and can be flexible on the amount of experience. Desired skills and expertise:
Completion of bachelor’s or masters degree in architecture. Masters preferred.
Ability to meet deadlines and to complete tasks accurately with strong attention to detail.
Experience producing design, permit and construction documents, specifications, etc. and managing a team.
Proficiency in Revit, Lumion/Enscape, AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and Rhino is a must with outstanding graphic presentation skills.
Interest in multidisciplinary design, shifting gears, and wearing multiple hats.
Excellent verbal, written and graphic communication skills. Must be a team player and work well with others.
Experience with commercial and/or single-family residential design preferred.
5-8 years experience desired.
Fluency in English is required.
What we offer:
Competitive salary depending on your level of experience
Paid vacation, holidays and sick leave that exceed industry standards
Full medical and dental coverage
401(k) with employer matching
WFH stipend
Professional licensure support
To apply, please submit cover letter indicating why you are a good fit, CV, and work samples to [email protected], including “Intermediate Designer/Architect” in the subject line. PDF files preferred.
